verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a per-endpoint API reference (e.g., the customer monitoring, exports, audit and transaction endpoints) and offers a first-party Postman collection that gives runnable requests. Its OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema is downloadable and was retrieved unauthenticated from /openapi/mesh-api.json; the 404s at other guessed paths do not contradict this. However, no evidence shows the reference itself is interactive (an in-browser 'try it' console or runnable examples embedded on the reference pages), so runnable examples rely on the separate Postman collection. Missing for 10: documented in-browser interactive try-it explorer, runnable code samples embedded in reference pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
